title: Quick quiz: how smart thermostats work
intro: Ten questions on the technology. Tap an answer to see why.

qs.q: What can a smart thermostat do that a basic one cannot?
options: Follow schedules and be controlled from your phone
Heat your house on its own
qs.why: It adds scheduling, remote control and usage reports to the same job.

qs.q: Why do many smart thermostats ask for a C-wire?
options: To power the screen and Wi-Fi all the time
qs.why: The common wire supplies steady power. Ask about an adapter if your wall has none.

qs.q: What should a heat pump thermostat support?
options: Heat pump wiring and auxiliary heat control
qs.why: Heat pumps use a reversing valve and a backup stage that need the right controls.

qs.q: What saves the most energy with a thermostat?
options: Not heating or cooling when nobody is home
Setting a higher temperature than you need
Switching it off and on often
qs.why: Setbacks work best when the home stays comfortable when you return.
Baseboards run on household voltage, so a regular smart thermostat may not fit. Check the rating.

qs.q: What can a utility program do with a connected thermostat?
options: Nudge your temperature briefly during peak demand
qs.why: You can usually override it, and it can earn you a payment.

options: Uses your phone's location to know when you leave or arrive
qs.why: It can switch to away mode when everyone leaves.

options: On an inside wall away from sun and vents
qs.why: Heat from sun, vents or appliances fools the sensor.

qs.q: With a heat pump, why avoid big temperature jumps?
options: A big jump can trigger costly backup heat
qs.why: Small, gradual changes let the heat pump do the work.

qs.q: What should you check before you buy?
options: What data it collects and who can see it
qs.why: Read the privacy settings and whether the app works without a subscription.
